name: KMG Special 2020

venue.name: NEXT Københavns Mediegymnasium
venue.details: Main entrance under the "Teknisk Skole" sign

information: ## Konkurrencen er aflyst pga. COVID-19 udbruddet! Denne konkurrence foregår i sammenhæng med FMC Europe. KMG Special vil slutte klokken 10 om søndagen hvor FMC Europe 2020 starter kort efter, også på KMG. FMC Europa er en seperat konkurrence. Hvis du vil deltage i FMC, skal du tilmelde dig FMC Europe seperat [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCEurope2020). Udover de officielle discipliner afholdes der teamblind. Hoveddisciplinen er 3x3 med bind for øjnene. _____________ ## The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak! This competition is happening in succession with FMC Europe 2020, a seperate competition which will be held at the same venue. If you want to compete in FMC you must sign up through [this link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCEurope2020) Teamblind will be held as an unofficial event. The Main event is 3x3 blindfolded.
